signals.title: Graduate Street and Degree Close, Belhar: off-duty police constable shot dead, 11 Nov
signals.content: An off-duty 28-year-old constable from the Belhar Crime Prevention Unit was shot dead by unknown suspects at the corner of Graduate Street and Degree Close, Belhar, at about 00:50 on Wednesday 11 November, Western Cape police spokesperson Constable Ndakhe Gwala confirmed to IOL and Smile 90.4FM. Smile 90.4FM reports the shooting happened during a suspected hijacking; police did not state a motive. A murder case was opened and handed to the Hawks, who said no arrests had been made. The map point is the Belhar suburb point, not the street corner.

signals.title: Outside Lingelethu West police station, Khayelitsha (map point approximate): man shot dead by off-duty constable after tavern quarrel, 20 Nov
signals.content: A man was shot dead outside the Lingelethu West police station in Khayelitsha at about 3.10am, after a quarrel at Ace's Park tavern with an off-duty constable from Public Order Policing in Faure, IPID spokesperson Phaladi Shuping told IOL and City Vision. IPID says the man followed the constable's car to the police station, where they quarrelled again and the constable allegedly shot him. Officers at the station then shot the constable, who was taken to hospital. IPID is investigating. The reports disagree on the date: IOL says the early hours of Friday 20 November, City Vision says Thursday 19 November. The map point is approximate: the Khayelitsha point, not the police station.

signals.title: Hlobe Street, Greenpoint, Khayelitsha (map point approximate): four men shot dead and eight wounded in tavern shooting, 21 Nov
signals.content: Four men were killed and eight people wounded when gunmen opened fire inside MaDlamini's Place tavern on Hlobe Street in the Greenpoint informal settlement, Khayelitsha, at about 11.30pm on Saturday 21 November, IOL and Cape Town ETC report from police. Police first said five were wounded; Western Cape Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Sizakhele Dyantyi later said the number rose to eight. Police say the gunmen fled in a vehicle hijacked at the scene, later found abandoned. Murder and attempted murder cases are being investigated; no motive or arrests were reported. The map point is approximate: the Khayelitsha point, not the tavern.

signals.title: Bartholomew Street, St Montague Village, Lavender Hill (map point approximate): 16-year-old shot dead and 13-year-old wounded, 23 Nov
signals.content: A 16-year-old boy was shot dead and a 13-year-old wounded when two unidentified men walked into Bartholomew Street, St Montague Village, Lavender Hill, and opened fire at about 6.15pm on Monday 23 November, Western Cape police spokesperson Lt-Col FC van Wyk told IOL. Voice of the Cape reports the same from police. IOL reports children were playing soccer in the street. Police believe the motive is gang-related; murder and attempted murder cases were opened and no arrests were reported. The children are not named. The map point is approximate: the Lavender Hill point, not the street.
